title: Prospective Experimental Protocol: Multi-Category Adaptive Cost-Weighted Budget Allocation (MACBA) for Human-in-the-Loop Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection
supersedes: None (Draft Proposal separate from frozen Protocol V2)
target_journals: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (T-PAMI)

hypothesis.primary_statement: In multi-product industrial manufacturing environments operating under a global bounded human review capacity (B <= 20% of total plant throughput), category-aware adaptive budget allocation driven by marginal error-density knapsack optimization and conformal quantile normalization achieves statistically superior Multi-Category Error Capture Rate (MC-ECR) and Net Financial Risk Reduction compared to uniform line splitting, global raw score pooling, or production-volume proportional allocation.
hypothesis.novelty_barrier: The proposed allocation method must demonstrate statistically significant improvement (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test across multi-category bootstrap resamples, p < 0.05, Holm-Bonferroni corrected) over both Uniform Category Allocation (BL0) and Global Distance Pooling (BL2) across independent evaluation categories without requiring defect training samples.
hypothesis.theoretical_scope: Bridges non-parametric visual anomaly detection with multi-choice knapsack resource allocation. Conformal calibration provides distribution-free standardization across disparate feature manifolds, while marginal utility triage optimizes human inspection yield under asymmetric economic penalties.

development_partition.name: MVTec AD — Multi-Category Development Subset
development_partition.role: Algorithmic development, tuning, and internal paired evaluation.

quarantined_independent_benchmarks.name: VisA (Visual Anomaly Dataset — 11 Untouched Categories)
quarantined_independent_benchmarks.quarantine_rule: Strictly quarantined until Protocol V3 is reviewed, frozen, and approved.

quarantined_independent_benchmarks.name: BTAD (BeanTech Anomaly Detection)
quarantined_independent_benchmarks.quarantine_rule: Strictly quarantined until Protocol V3 is reviewed, frozen, and approved.

stages.description: Conformal Quantile Normalization using nominal calibration splits to map incommensurable raw scores S_c(X) into standardized nominal non-conformity percentiles.
Empirical marginal expected cost reduction curve estimation Delta_Cost_c(k) for each production line as a function of allocated inspection reviews k.
Multi-choice knapsack optimization solving for optimal per-line review quotas K_c* subject to sum K_c <= B_total and operational minimum floor K_min,c.
Within-line prioritization ordering specimens by cost-weighted boundary proximity |S_c(X) - tau_c| * lambda_c.

baselines: BL0: Uniform Category Allocation (K_c = B / C)

stopping_and_failure_criteria.stop_rule_1: If MACBA fails to outperform Uniform Allocation (BL0) by at least +5.0% MC-ECR at 10% budget on internal development validation.
stopping_and_failure_criteria.stop_rule_2: If the allocation algorithm requires retraining backbones or incurs > 100 ms optimization latency per batch.
stopping_and_failure_criteria.stop_rule_3: If any independent VisA category is unblinded prior to formal protocol freeze.
